# Morocco Golden Tours

> > Morocco Golden Tours offers curated desert tours, camel trekking, and adventure experiences across Morocco's most iconic destinations including the Sahara, Atlas Mountains, and Berber cultural sites.

Morocco Golden Tours specializes in personalized travel experiences throughout Morocco, featuring multi-day tours from major cities like Marrakech, Fes, Tangier, and Agadir. The company offers a wide range of desert adventures including camel trekking in Merzouga, 4x4 and quad biking tours, hot air balloon rides, and cultural excursions to natural landmarks.

## Tours by Departure City

- [Tours From Marrakech](https://moroccogoldentours.com/morocco-tours-from-marrakech): Desert and city tours from Marrakech including Sahara and Atlas Mountains
- [Tours From Fes](https://moroccogoldentours.com/morocco-tours-from-fes): Sahara Desert tours and trips departing from Fes with camel trekking
- [Tours From Tangier](https://moroccogoldentours.com/morocco-tours-from-tangier): Morocco tours from Tangier visiting Chefchaouen, Fes, and Sahara Desert
- [Tours From Agadir](https://moroccogoldentours.com/morocco-tours-from-agadir): Desert tours from Agadir exploring Sahara, Anti-Atlas Mountains

## Merzouga Desert Adventures

- [Merzouga Camel Trekking](https://moroccogoldentours.com/merzouga-camel-trekking-activity): Merzouga camel trekking in Erg Chebbi dunes with sunset and overnight stays
- [Merzouga 4x4 Desert Tours](https://moroccogoldentours.com/merzouga-4x4-desert-tours): 4x4 desert tours in Merzouga exploring Sahara and Berber culture
- [Merzouga Quad Biking](https://moroccogoldentours.com/merzouga-quad-tour): Quad biking adventure in Merzouga's Erg Chebbi dunes with guided tours
- [Merzouga KTM Motorcycle Tours](https://moroccogoldentours.com/merzouga-ktm-tours): KTM motorcycle tours in Merzouga's Erg Chebbi dunes for adventure seekers
- [Merzouga Buggy Tours](https://moroccogoldentours.com/merzouga-buggy): Buggy tours in Merzouga exploring Sahara dunes and nomad experiences
- [Merzouga Horse Riding](https://moroccogoldentours.com/merzouga-horse-riding): Horse riding tours in Merzouga's Sahara Desert with sunrise and sunset rides

## Multi-Day Tours

- [3-Day Tour from Marrakech to Merzouga](https://moroccogoldentours.com/3-days-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga): 3-day tour from Marrakech to Merzouga via Atlas Mountains and kasbahs

## Day Excursions & Activities

- [Marrakech Hot Air Balloon Ride](https://moroccogoldentours.com/marrakech-balloon): Hot air balloon rides over Atlas Mountains with Berber breakfast
- [Ouzoud Waterfalls Tour](https://moroccogoldentours.com/ouzoud-waterfalls-tour): Day trip to Ouzoud Waterfalls from Marrakech with scenic nature views
- [Agafay Desert Day Pass](https://moroccogoldentours.com/agafay-desert-day-pass): Agafay Desert day pass with pool, lunch, quad biking, and camel rides
- [Marrakech Quad Biking](https://moroccogoldentours.com/marrakech-quad-biking): Quad biking in Marrakech's Agafay Desert with cultural experiences
- [Ouarzazate Day Trip](https://moroccogoldentours.com/ouarzazate-day-trip): Day trip from Marrakech to Ouarzazate and Ait Ben Haddou kasbah
